claims: Justin Bieber headlined a 34-song set on April 12 at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
Justin Bieber's set at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival featured surprise appearances by Tems and Wizkid.
Justin Bieber brought out Wizkid and Tems during his headlining set at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
Tems performed "I Think You're Special" alongside Justin Bieber at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
Justin Bieber, Tems, and Wizkid performed the "Essence (Remix)" at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
The performance of the "Essence (Remix)" followed Tems' solo performance of "I Think You're Special" with Justin Bieber.
Tems, Wizkid, and Justin Bieber collaborated on the remix of "Essence".
